title: The Penthouse*Walk to Broadway* PrintersAlleyLofts
description:
LEVEL BEST–Printers Alley Lofts’ stunning 1,509 sq. ft. two-level 2BR penthouse with funky art, modern style, and plenty of space to spread out, just steps from Nashville’s hottest spots. Stay in the heart of downtown at the Penthouse Loft in historic Printers Alley. Patio at entrance for all guests to relax with morning coffee or evening drinks. Parking is nearby but not included. ☆ A FEW EXTRAS: Ask about other Printers Alley Lofts for smaller or larger groups, or if you need additional space.

The space
★ THE PENTHOUSE LOFT ★

Welcome to the Penthouse at Printers Alley Lofts — a stunning 1,509 sq. ft. two-level retreat that blends upscale comfort with downtown Nashville energy.

☆ This 2BR/2BA penthouse is designed for both style and convenience. Each bedroom features its own private ensuite bathroom, offering guests added comfort and privacy. The upstairs suite includes a tub/shower combo, perfect for a relaxing soak after a day in Music City.

☆ Step inside and you’ll be greeted by soaring ceilings, bold artwork, and chic modern furnishings that create a vibrant yet inviting atmosphere. The bright, open-concept living area is ideal for lounging with family or friends, while the fully equipped gourmet kitchen makes dining in a breeze with premium appliances, cookware, and ample seating.

☆ For entertainment and relaxation, unwind in the spacious living room, enjoy high-speed WiFi, or stream your favorite shows on the Smart TVs. Natural light floods the loft through large windows, highlighting the loft’s unique architectural character and city views.

☆ Outside your door, step onto the shared outdoor patio—a cozy spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails. And when it’s time to explore, you’re just steps away from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, world-class dining, and Nashville’s legendary live music scene.

☆ With its unbeatable location, stylish design, and thoughtful amenities, the Penthouse at Printers Alley Lofts is the perfect choice for travelers seeking an elevated urban escape in the heart of Music City.

★ A FEW EXTRAS TO KEEP IN MIND!  We offer 10 unique lofts at Printers Alley Lofts, all listed on Airbnb. If your preferred dates are unavailable or you’re traveling with a larger group, you can book multiple lofts either within the building or next door in our adjoining Printers Alley Lofts building to accommodate everyone.  
☆ 1 Bedrooms (max 4 guests): Flat Loft, Suite Loft, Studio Loft (sleep sofa in living area) 
☆ 2 Bedrooms (max 6 guests | Deluxe PH up to 8 guests): City Loft Penthouse, Penthouse, Deluxe Penthouse 
☆ 4 Bedrooms (max 12 guests): Grand Loft, Urban Loft, Printers Alley Penthouse 
☆ 5 Bedrooms (max 12 guests): Gallery Loft (back living area sectional sofa includes two twin mattresses) 

★ Printers Alley Lofts – FAQ

Q: CAN WE CHECK IN EARLY OR CHECK OUT LATE?
A: When possible, yes. Because we receive many last-minute bookings, we can only confirm availability the night before your arrival or departure.

Q: CAN YOU STORE OUR LUGGAGE IF EARLY CHECK-IN ISN’T AVAILABLE?
A: Yes. We’re happy to store your luggage when early check-in or late checkout isn’t possible. Availability will be confirmed the evening before.

Q: IT’S A 2 BEDROOM LOFT—HOW CAN IT SLEEP 6 PEOPLE?
A: Our rates are based on double occupancy—two guests per bedroom. This two-bedroom loft includes a base rate for up to 4 guests. We can accommodate up to 6 guests total (two additional guests) for $75 per extra guest, per night, plus taxes. For groups over 4, we provide one queen air mattress with bedding and linens up to a maximum of 6 guests.

Q: IS PARKING INCLUDED?
A: Parking is not included, but several secure garages are within walking distance (average $45/24 hrs). Our property manager can point out nearby options at check-in.

Q: DO YOU OFFER ADDITIONAL LOFTS?
A: Yes! We have multiple lofts in the building and next door, ranging from 1–5 bedrooms. Perfect for groups needing more space. Printers Alley Lofts includes 10 lofts housed in two adjoining buildings on Printers Alley—8 are located in one building, and 2 are in the adjoining building right next door.

Q: HOW DO I CHECK IN?
A: Check-in instructions will be sent prior to arrival. Our property manager will greet you and assist with any questions.

Q: IN ADDITION TO THE NIGHTLY RENTAL, WHAT OTHER FEES ARE CHARGED BY PRINTERS ALLEY LOFTS?
A: In addition to the nightly rate, there is a one-time departure cleaning fee, as well as required state and local taxes. Current tax charges are:
Tax – 0.5% Davidson County Local Options Sales Tax Surcharge
Tax – 7% Davidson County Sales Tax
Tax – 9.25% Tennessee State Sales Tax
Tax – $2.50 per night Tennessee Occupancy Tax
We do not add resort fees or hidden charges—only the above apply.

Q: IS THERE A DAMAGE DEPOSIT. 
A: Yes, we place a $500 pre-authorization hold on your card before arrival. It works just like a hotel—nothing is charged unless there’s damage, and if all is well, the hold is released shortly after checkout.

Q: ARE YOU AFFILIATED WITH MARKETING CHANNEL FEES?
A: No. If your inquiry came through a marketing channel, their service fees are strictly between you and them. We are not affiliated with their charges.

Q: DO YOU HAVE A GYM ON SITE?
A: We do not have a gym. However, several gyms in downtown Nashville offer day passes for out-of-town guests. QNTM Fit Life offers 1–2 day passes and weekly options, and Anytime Fitness allows drop-in visits. Printers Alley Lofts is not affiliated with these gyms.

Q: DO YOU HAVE A POOL OR GRILL?
A: Printers Alley Lofts does not offer a pool. Some lofts do feature a grill and/or private outdoor space:
Gallery Loft – private patio
Grand Loft – private balcony
Printers Alley Penthouse – large terrace with seating and grill
In addition, there is a common area patio with tables and chairs available for all guests of Printers Alley Lofts, located at the entrance of our main Printers Alley Lofts building.

Q: WILL IT BE NOISY SINCE THE LOFTS ARE DOWNTOWN?
A: Our building is located in the heart of Downtown Nashville. While our windows are STC-rated and block most noise, some city sounds may still be heard. We seldom receive complaints, but want guests to be aware of our central location. We cannot assume responsibility for external factors such as nearby events, construction, or nightlife.

Q: ARE PETS ALLOWED?
A: Dogs only are permitted, with a non-refundable pet fee of $75 per dog plus taxes (maximum of 2 dogs). No other animals are allowed.

Q: WHO HANDLES MAINTENANCE?
A: Printers Alley Lofts is a multi-residential complex where building management oversees amenities, shared spaces, and exterior maintenance. This includes plumbing, electrical, and HVAC. Please note that these items follow building protocols and timelines for resolution.

Q: ARE THERE GROCERY STORES AND LIQUOR STORES NEARBY PRINTERS ALLEY?
A: Yes! Here are the closest options within walking distance or a quick drive from the lofts:
GROCERY STORES
Savi Provisions – 0.2 miles (4-min walk)
Whole Foods – 0.7 miles (15-min walk / 5-min drive)
Publix – 1.0 mile (20-min walk / 6-min drive)
Corner Market (mini-mart) – 0.2 miles (4-min walk)
LIQUOR STORES
Music City Wine & Spirits – 0.2 miles (4-min walk)
Metropolitan Wines – 0.3 miles (5-min walk)
SoBro Wine & Spirits – 0.5 miles (10-min walk / 3-min drive)
The Library Fine Wine & Spirits – 0.4 miles (8-min walk)
Frugal MacDoogal Warehouse – 1.0 mile (20-min walk / 5-min drive)

Q: IS THERE ICE IN THE REFRIGERATOR?
A: For sanitary reasons, the ice makers in the fridges are turned off, as we dump the bins after each checkout to ensure cleanliness. Since the ice makers can’t replenish quickly enough for our back-to-back bookings, we keep them off. No worries—you can grab a bag of ice just half a block away at the nearby mini mart.

Q. WHAT TYPE OF COFFEE MAKER IS THERE?
A. We have a traditional drip coffee maker in each loft with a reusable mesh filter (not a Keurig).

Guest access
★ Our property manager will personally greet you at check-in and share tips about the loft and Nashville.

★ You’ll set your own private access code—secure, keyless entry with no keys to worry about.

★ Guests enjoy the entire loft privately, while the lobby is shared.

Other things to note
★ FEATURES & AMENITIES

☆ Two-Level Penthouse Loft – Spacious layout with modern design and vibrant character.
☆ 2 Spacious Bedrooms – Both with plush king beds, luxe linens, and stylish touches.
☆ 2 Full Bathrooms – Designed for comfort and convenience.
☆ Fully Equipped Kitchen – Cook with ease using premium appliances and cookware.
☆ Bright, Open Living Space – Filled with funky art, modern décor, and natural light.
☆ High-Speed WiFi & 3 Smart TVs – Stream, work, or relax with ease across multiple rooms.
☆ In-Unit Washer & Dryer – Convenient for longer stays.
☆ Central Air & Heat – Stay comfortable year-round.
☆ Shared Outdoor Patio – Seating area to enjoy Nashville’s vibrant downtown vibe.
☆ Prime Location – Just steps from top bars, live music venues, and attractions.
